about: Every generation made through the media desk (https://studio.agents.sovereignweb.site/productions/higgsfield/desk.json), from the first call: date, tool, what was made, for whom, amount and outcome. Kept by higgsfield.c. No key or token is ever written here. Spend: no cap for now, every cost recorded (Dinis Cruz, 28 Nov 2026).

fields.date: UTC date and time of the generation
fields.tool: Service and model or mode, e.g. Higgsfield <model>
fields.what: What was made (still, clip, texture), size, and the prompt
fields.for: The agent and page, film or test it was for
fields.amount: Credits as the account shows them
fields.why: One sentence: why usable or not
fields.vault: Vault id and path of the file
